title: 第66章 撤军回国，颗粒归仓！
content_zh:
第66章 撤军回国，颗粒归仓！-《文豪1978：从军旅作家开始》

工厂内，黄连长听取了刘济民的建议，开始命令部队节省炸药，要以最少的炸药，给越南人以最大的打击。
“撤出工厂，准备爆破！”
双方部队撤出工厂后，在黄连长的一声令下，众人先听到巨大的轰鸣声，接着看到建筑在浓烟中轰然倒塌。
等浓烟散去，工厂半边耸立半边塌，等越南人回来收拾，也要好一阵子。
“电线杆给我炸一半留一半！”刘济民看到电线杆，大声地说道。
“是！”
在跟随工程兵部队行动的时候，九连战士充分发挥了创造性思维，让越南人回来的时候，欲哭无泪。
“指导员，我看着大楼就把承重墙炸了就行！”
“指导员，路给狗日的炸了！”
“执行命令！”
“是！”
“指导员，这楼里竟然有个仓库，有自行车还有大米白面，还有牙膏！”
刘济民进去一看，里面的大米上还写着“中国援助”的字样，自行车都是“凤凰”或者“永久”军用加重型自行车，专为越南丛林设计。
“东西拉出去，楼的承重墙炸了！妈的，这些都是咱们的东西。”刘济民大手一挥，战士们开始往外抬。
“指导员，这里有美国人的东西。”
“都抬回去，帮狗日的越南人搞拆迁，不得给咱们点承包款！”刘济民冲旁边的战士说道：“炸药埋好点，别把整栋楼给炸塌了，人家回来还得接着拆呢！”
“指导员，咱们炸一半，越南人回来还得感谢咱呢！”
“这些都是咱们援助的牙膏啊！上海牌的，都是好东西。等回去登记后，全部分发给个人！”
工业和军用物资都上交了，大部分民用物资都是各部队内部消化了。战士们的津贴都不多，这些东西能很大程度上补贴战士们的用度。
部队从城区开始搞拆迁，接着是郊区的工厂。禄平地区的工厂相对少点，谅山地区的拆除量更大。

Chapter 66: Withdraw the troops and return to the country, and return the grains to the warehouse! - "Literary Master 1978: Beginning as a Military Writer"

In the factory, Captain Huang listened to Liu Jimin's suggestion and began to order the troops to save explosives, so as to use the least explosives to deal the greatest blow to the Vietnamese.
"Evacuate the factory and prepare to blast!"
After the troops from both sides withdrew from the factory, under the order of Captain Huang, everyone first heard a huge roar, and then saw the building collapse in the thick smoke.
When the smoke cleared, half of the factory stood and half collapsed. It would take a while for the Vietnamese to come back and clean it up.
"Blow up half of the telephone poles and leave the other half!" Liu Jimin said loudly when he saw the telephone poles.
"Yes!"
When following the action of the engineering troops, the soldiers of the Ninth Company gave full play to their creative thinking and made the Vietnamese feel like crying when they came back.
"Instructor, I just need to blow up the load-bearing walls while looking at the building!"
"Instructor, the road is crazy!"
"Execute the order!"
"Yes!"
"Instructor, there is actually a warehouse in this building, with bicycles, rice noodles, and toothpaste!"
Liu Jimin went in and took a look. The words "China Aid" were written on the rice inside. The bicycles were all "Phoenix" or "Permanent" military heavy-duty bicycles, specially designed for the jungles of Vietnam.
"When the things were pulled out, the load-bearing wall of the building exploded! Damn, these are all our things." Liu Jimin waved his hand, and the soldiers began to carry them out.
"Instructor, there is something American here."
"Carry them all back to help the stubborn Vietnamese with demolition. Don't give us any contract money!" Liu Jimin said to the soldiers next to him: "bury the explosives well, don't blow up the whole building. They will have to continue demolishing it when they come back!"
"Instructor, if we blow up half of it, the Vietnamese will have to thank us when they come back!"
"These are the toothpastes we donated! They are Shanghai brand, and they are all good things. After we go back to register, we will distribute them all to individuals!"
Industrial and military supplies were all handed over, and most civilian supplies were digested internally by each army. The soldiers' allowances are not many, and these things can greatly subsidize the soldiers' expenses.
The troops started demolishing factories in urban areas and then moved on to factories in the suburbs. There are relatively few factories in Loc Binh area, while the number of demolitions in Lang Son area is larger.
